title: 第6章 来自新人的指挥
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

新人想在职业队拿到指挥权，难度不亚于抢班夺权。

因为“指挥”这两个字，在电竞竞技里从来不只是“谁游戏理解高”这么简单。它背后交织着更复杂的队内地位、资历、话语权，甚至是战队资源的绝对分配。

许多顶级战队分崩离析的诱因，本质上都埋在麦克风里。

AD觉得辅助应该死保下路，自己才能接管比赛；中单觉得打野就是自己的栓狗，该无限围着中路转；上单觉得自己能C，不帮就是孤儿战术。

打野？打野还觉得你们都应该跟着我进野区帮我压制对面打野呢。

连胜的时候，这些矛盾还能被胜利压下去。

可一旦开始输，尤其是令人窒息的连败袭来时，休息室的气氛会瞬间爆炸。因为每个自命不凡的天才都会在心里默认同一个逻辑：输比赛，是因为你们没按我的思路打。

而2016年的LGD，恰恰是这种畸形生态的典型。

纸面配置豪华，独独发动机跛脚。

MaRin是FMVP，Imp也是冠军ad，PYL和Godv都是国产知名选手。

而负责把这群神仙串联起来的发动机，偏偏是Eimy。一个刚刚摸到LPL门槛没多久的新人打野。

后世的观众提起Eimy，大多只会调侃一句戏谑的野王。

可鲜有人知道，他的职业道路有多坎坷。

2013年出道，他的起点是一家叫CC的网吧战队。

那时候的中国电竞远没有后来的光鲜亮丽，很多赛训基地就是黑网吧。CC战队在历史上留下的唯一一抹色彩，大概就是爆冷赢过一次当时如日中天的天团OMG。

而当时CC战队的教练，是多年后爆火的大司马。

后来Eimy辗转去了UP战队，在那里，他经历了残酷的LPL保级赛。他们输了。战队跌落LSPL的深渊。

草根出身的新人打野，最致命的顽疾就是丧失判断力。

因为在高度紧张的比赛里，你根本不知道该听谁的。上路在喊“能抓”，中路在叫“来蹲”，下路也在疯狂发信号。

五个人各执一词。

以前的Eimy就经常陷入这种精神内耗。

他想帮上，中路打旗子，下路开始抱怨。

最后的结果就是人打麻了，思路乱了，节奏彻底断档。

今天的比赛格外安静，PYL没有开玩笑，imp也没有操着带有口音的普通话说兄弟们随便赢，Marin？Marin一贯不和他们说话，他一般只会在比赛里说很少的话，adad、apap之类的。

最多在BP阶段，和教练Heart用韩语简单的交流两句。

今天从开场开始就没人说话，BP阶段Heart教练说什么，都没人反驳，大家只是默默选下教练说的英雄。

就好像，大家都不认为今天这场比赛能赢一样。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

For a newcomer to gain command in a professional team, it is no less difficult than grabbing a class to gain power.

Because the word "commander" in e-sports is never as simple as "who understands the game better".Behind it are intertwined more complex status, seniority, voice, and even the absolute allocation of team resources.

The reasons why many top teams fall apart are essentially buried in the microphone.

AD believes that the support should protect the bottom lane so that he can take over the game; the mid laner feels that the jungler is his anchor dog and should revolve around the middle lane indefinitely; the top laner feels that he can C, and not helping him is an orphan tactic.

Jungle?The jungler also thinks that you should all follow me into the jungle and help me suppress the opponent's jungler.

During a winning streak, these conflicts can be suppressed by victory.

But once you start losing, especially when a suffocating losing streak hits, the atmosphere in the lounge will instantly explode.Because every self-proclaimed genius will default to the same logic in his heart: he lost the game because you didn't play according to my ideas.

And LGD in 2016 is exactly a typical example of this abnormal ecology.

The configuration is luxurious on paper, but the engine is lame.

MaRin is FMVP, Imp is also the champion AD, and PYL and Godv are both well-known domestic players.

And the engine responsible for connecting these gods together is Eimy.A new jungler who has just touched the threshold of LPL.

When later generations of audiences mention Eimy, most of them will only make fun of the wild king.

But few people know how bumpy his career path has been.

Debuting in 2013, he started from an Internet cafe team called CC.

At that time, Chinese e-sports was far less glamorous than it was later, and many training bases were black Internet cafes.The only trace of color left in the history of the CC team is probably its upset victory over OMG, which was at the height of its popularity at the time.

The coach of the CC team at the time was Da Sima, who became popular many years later.

Eimy later moved to the UP team, where he experienced the brutal LPL relegation match.They lost.The team fell into the abyss of LSPL.

The most fatal disease for new junglers with grassroots background is the loss of judgment.

Because in a highly tense game, you don't know who to listen to.The top lane is shouting "can catch", the middle lane is shouting "come squat", and the bottom lane is also sending signals frantically.

Each of the five people held their own opinions.

In the past, Eimy often fell into this kind of mental internal conflict.

He wanted to help, flagged in the middle lane, and started complaining in the bottom lane.

The final result is that people feel paralyzed, their thoughts are confused, and their rhythm is completely interrupted.

Today's game was extremely quiet. PYL didn't make any jokes, and imp didn't speak Mandarin with an accent and say that brothers can win casually, Marin?Marin never talks to them. He usually only says a few words during the game, such as adad, apap and the like.

At most, during the BP stage, I would exchange a few simple sentences with coach Heart in Korean.

No one spoke from the beginning today. No one refuted what Coach Heart said during the BP stage. Everyone just silently picked the hero the coach said.

It's like no one thinks they can win today's game.
